title: THE GOLDEN ENEMY MARK COUNTS ITS CLUES RIGHT
why: The golden enemy mark on the sector map says how many clues are still out there. With one left it read GOLDEN ENEMY  1 CLUES, and with all three taken (when the mark pins to the golden enemy) it read GOLDEN ENEMY  0 CLUES. Proven in headless Chromium on real frames: two clues taken, the map drew GOLDEN ENEMY  1 CLUES; three taken, GOLDEN ENEMY  0 CLUES. It now reads 1 CLUE, 2 CLUES and so on, and plain GOLDEN ENEMY once none are left.
now: The golden enemy mark now reads 1 CLUE, not 1 CLUES, and drops the count once every clue is taken.
